measures.id: City of Marysville Proposed Charter Amendment (By Petition)
measures.title: To enact Article IV, Section 4.03, Referendum Petition, of the Charter of the City of Marysville
measures.summary: This citizen-petition amendment would add a section to the Marysville city charter on referendum petitions. People filing a referendum petition on a city ordinance would no longer have to first file a certified copy of the ordinance with the Director of Finance before circulating it. A referendum petition would need signatures from ten percent of the number of city electors who voted for governor in the most recent governor's election and would be filed with the Director of Finance.
measures.yesMeans: Section 4.03 on referendum petitions would be added to the Marysville charter.
measures.noMeans: The charter would not be changed, and current referendum petition rules would stay in place.
